title: A Jump-Modified Wasserstein Gradient Flow for Maximum Mean Discrepancy with Energy Kernels
abstract: arXiv:2610.29007v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study a jump-modified Wasserstein gradient flow of the squared maximum mean discrepancy generated by the energy kernels $K(z)=-|z|^q$, $0<2$, in every dimension $d\ge2$ as well as the one-dimensional range $1\le q<2$. Under subcritical density and finite-moment assumptions, we prove global well-posedness. The added jumps transfer mass toward smaller values of the first variation and dissipate the same MMD energy as the transport term. Under our hypotheses on the target and jump rates, every Borel probability measure with finite MMD energy and zero jump dissipation is equal to the target. Combining this rigidity with compactness and a second-moment identity yields convergence to the target from finite-second-moment data, without additional uniform-in-time density or moment assumptions. We also construct a global collision-free particle process whose energy is nonincreasing along each path. A quantitative mean-field estimate applies t

translated_title: 基于能量核的最大均值差异的跳跃修正Wasserstein梯度流
translated_abstract: 我们研究由能量核 $K(z)=-|z|^q$（在每一维 $d\ge2$ 时 $0<q<2$，以及一维情形 $1\le q<2$）生成的平方最大均值差异（MMD）的跳跃修正Wasserstein梯度流。在次临界密度和有限矩假设下，我们证明了全局适定性。所引入的跳跃项将质量转移向一阶变分较小的取值，并与输运项耗散相同的MMD能量。在我们对目标测度和跳跃速率的假设下，每个具有有限MMD能量且跳跃耗散为零的Borel概率测度都等于目标测度。将这一刚性结果与紧性及二阶矩恒等式相结合，可以从仅具有有限二阶矩的初始数据得到向目标测度的收敛，而无需额外的一致时间密度或矩假设。我们还构造了一个全局无碰撞的粒子过程，其能量沿每条路径单调不增。定量平均场估计适用于……
tldr: 本文提出一种带跳跃项的修正Wasserstein梯度流来最小化能量核生成的最大均值差异（MMD），证明了该流的全局适定性、仅凭有限二阶矩即可收敛到目标分布，并构造了能量单调不增的全局无碰撞粒子过程。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a jump-modified Wasserstein gradient flow for minimizing the maximum mean discrepancy with energy kernels, proving global well-posedness, convergence to the target from merely finite-second-moment data, and constructing a global collision-free particle process with nonincreasing energy.
